name: Anthropic (Claude API)
summary: Claude models through Anthropic's own API: messages, token counting, model list and batch jobs.

api_key.description: A Claude API key (platform.claude.com > API Keys).

notes: Every request carries anthropic-version; this entry pins 2026-10-21, under which temperature, top_p and top_k are removed and any of them is a 400.
Billed per input and output token at the model's price; the response's usage block gives the counts.
A key that can act on several workspaces needs the anthropic-workspace-id header; a workspace-scoped key does not.
Request size limits: 128 MB for messages and token counting, 256 MB for a batch.

endpoints.name: Create a message
endpoints.summary: Send a conversation to a Claude model and get its reply.

model.description: Model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5; list them with anthropic.models.list.

max_tokens.description: Most tokens to generate; the model may stop sooner. Maximum depends on the model.

messages.description: Conversation as alternating user/assistant messages, each {role, content}; content is a string or a list of content blocks.

system.description: System prompt: a string, or an array of text blocks.

tools.description: Tool definitions the model may call.

tool_choice.description: How the model should use the tools, e.g. {"type": "auto"}.

thinking.description: Thinking configuration: {"type": "adaptive"}, or {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": N} with N >= 1024; accepted types depend on the model.

output_config.description: Output options: effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) and format ({"type": "json_schema", "schema": {...}}) for structured output.

service_tier.description: auto (priority capacity when available) or standard_only.

notes: A read over POST: it creates nothing on the account, but is billed per token.
Do not set stream: true; this client returns one JSON body.

endpoints.name: Count tokens in a message
endpoints.summary: Input token count for a request, including tools, images and documents, without sending it.

model.description: Model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5; list them with anthropic.models.list.

messages.description: Conversation as alternating user/assistant messages, each {role, content}; content is a string or a list of content blocks.

system.description: System prompt: a string, or an array of text blocks.

tools.description: Tool definitions the model may call.

tool_choice.description: How the model should use the tools, e.g. {"type": "auto"}.

thinking.description: Thinking configuration: {"type": "adaptive"}, or {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": N} with N >= 1024; accepted types depend on the model.

endpoints.name: List models
endpoints.summary: Models available to the key, newest first.

after_id.description: Cursor: return the page after this model id.

before_id.description: Cursor: return the page before this model id.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stages to include: active, deprecated, retired. Default active and deprecated.

notes: Page with the last_id/first_id and has_more fields of the response.

endpoints.name: Get a model
endpoints.summary: One model's details by id or alias.

endpoints.name: Create a message batch
endpoints.summary: Submit up to 100,000 message requests to run asynchronously.

requests.description: Items of {custom_id, params}: custom_id is 1-64 characters [a-zA-Z0-9_-], unique in the batch; params is a full messages.create body.

notes: Asynchronous: processing starts at once and can take up to 24 hours. Poll anthropic.batches.get until processing_status is ended, then read anthropic.batches.results.
Billed per token for each request in it.

endpoints.name: Get a message batch
endpoints.summary: A batch's processing_status (in_progress, canceling, ended), request counts and results_url.

endpoints.name: Get message batch results
endpoints.summary: The results of an ended batch, one JSON object per request.
notes: The body is a .jsonl file, one JSON object per line, not a single JSON document.
Results are not in request order: match them by custom_id.
